newsitem.title: USA: W.House wants minimum wage for workfare recipients-NYT.
newsitem.headline: W.House wants minimum wage for workfare recipients-NYT.

text.p: The White House said welfare recipients placed in work programs should be covered by minimum-wage laws, The New York Times reported on Friday.
The newspaper said the legal interpretation of last year's welfare bill has surprised and angered some governors, as well as authors of the bill, who believe it will undermine the intent of the law.
Critics contend that the interpretation would sharply increase the cost of running the program -- and could discourage recipients from leaving the welfare rolls for private jobs.

"This could really hamper what we're trying to do,' said Rep. E. Clay Shaw Jr, a Florida Republican and an author of the bill. "It could drastically cut back the hours that welfare recipients are required to work."
The issue has been under review for months and appeared to have grown out of an oversight in drafting the legislation, which did not expressly outline when minimum-wage laws applied, the report said.
